meta.markings_note: lane lines, centre lines, crosswalk stripes and stop lines are emitted only from a licensed marking-line dataset; none exists for this city, so lines / crosswalks / stop_lines are empty
meta.method: no prediction: road polygons are the LiDAR paved corridor (0.5 m raster of ground returns; per-way intensity signature + smoothness < 3 cm, bounded by 6-35 cm curb steps and buildings; 1 m perpendicular profiles, 9 m along-road median, Chaikin-smoothed); OSM ways without a measured corridor are not drawn; everything clipped to the LiDAR square; control points / crossings / lamps / footways at their exact OSM positions
meta.frame: local metres east/north of meta.origin (Web-Mercator metres / k, as houses.json); z = metres above meta.z_base
